Module cache 

Source
Expand description

Caching detector results between solves.

An entry is keyed on the registration identity, the registered names and the environment digest, and it always expires: after the lifetime the report asked for, clamped to the protocol’s maximum, at the next reboot for "REBOOT" results, and early when a watched path or variable changes. Entries are JSON files written atomically, so concurrent readers never see a partial file.

Structs§

CacheClock
The time and boot session against which entries are validated. Passed explicitly so the expiry rules can be tested deterministically.
CacheKey
What identifies a cached result.
CachedResult
A cached result as stored on disk.
ResultCache
The on-disk cache of detector results.
WatchedPath
A watched path and its state when the entry was written.
WatchedVariable
A watched environment variable and a fingerprint of its value when the entry was written. Only the fingerprint is stored: a detector may watch variables that hold credentials, and the cache file must not leak them.
